status: Unpublished routed ignition-lead and coil-bracket candidate; see validation report

primary_sources.claim: The applicable Ford cable description specifies a carbon-impregnated multifilament synthetic-fiber core, heat-resistant rubber insulation and resistance for interference suppression.
primary_sources.limits: No cable diameter, strand count, resistance value, boot profile or routing dimensions supplied.

primary_sources.claim: Original factory firing-order diagram visually reviewed: front cylinder is 1; sequence is 1-5-3-6-2-4; cap arrow is clockwise viewed from above.
primary_sources.limits: The schematic illustrates a number-1 tower, but the model housing clocking has not been surveyed. The model's chosen local +X number-1 tower is not asserted as the production clocking.

primary_sources.claim: Ford distributor service procedure preserves the marked number-1 tower position and requires initial timing adjustment after installation.
Ford coil service procedure identifies a separate secondary ignition wire and coil-to-bracket retaining screws.
primary_sources.limits: The procedure does not establish this bracket shape, screw count, head boss locations or modeled fastener dimensions.

electrical_topology.coil_lead: coil high-voltage terminal to cap center terminal
electrical_topology.individual_lead_construction: A continuous carbon-core envelope inside hollow rubber insulation, with separate insulating boots and metal contacts at both ends.

mounting.basis: The frame reuses four pre-existing provisional coil-core holes; two illustrative head bosses establish a connected load path. No surveyed Ford bracket geometry is claimed.

integration: Call cap_interface on the already extended distributor-cap definition, after oil_drive_layout.distributor_definition.
Call head_interface on the head-local casting before publishing it; it adds matching mounting bosses and bores.
Call build((define,add,group)) after the ignition system root exists.
Treat jacket, boot and carbon-core materials as nonmetallic in the viewer.
Use the candidate validator before publishing; original cap and head STEP assets remain untouched by this module.
limits: Lead lengths and routes are fit-study outputs, not replacement-cable specifications.
Boot cavities have visible modeling clearances; seal compression and terminal spring pressure are not simulated.
The carbon-core envelope does not individually model fiber strands or calculate impedance.
No operating high-voltage, timing, thermal, vibration or flexibility simulation is claimed.
